Someone told me Echo of Harmonies can be played on an Ancient
Influence in my ash heap, and still has the effect despite the only

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
DeistMutts wrote:
:: Someone told me Echo of Harmonies can be played on an Ancient

:: Influence in my ash heap, and still has the effect despite the only
:: one in game rule is called.. is that true? If not, then I gotta
:: dismantle this deck I built a while ago:(

Yes and no. You can put the ancient influence on the vampire playing Echoes
of Harmony, but the vote can't be called. So the card will stay here for a
nice decorative touch.
